question_text: Aids to trade are
option_a: Services that facilitate trade
explanation: Aids to trade facilitate buying and selling.

question_text: Which of the following is an aid to trade?
option_a: Banking
explanation: Banking facilitates trade.

question_text: Banking is best defined as
option_a: The business of accepting deposits and lending money
explanation: Banking involves deposits and lending.

question_text: Which of the following is a function of a commercial bank?
option_a: Accepting deposits
explanation: Commercial banks accept deposits.

question_text: A current account is an account
option_a: From which money can be withdrawn at any time
explanation: Current accounts allow anytime withdrawal.

question_text: A savings account is an account
option_a: For saving money and earning interest
option_b: From which money is withdrawn by cheque
explanation: Savings accounts earn interest.

question_text: A fixed deposit account is an account
option_a: Where money is deposited for a fixed period at interest
option_b: From which money is withdrawn at any time
explanation: Fixed deposits are for a fixed term.

question_text: Which account usually attracts the lowest interest?
option_a: Current account
explanation: Current accounts usually earn little or no interest.

question_text: Which account usually attracts the highest interest?
option_a: Fixed deposit account
explanation: Fixed deposits attract higher interest.

question_text: A cheque is
option_a: An order to a bank to pay a specified sum to a named person
explanation: A cheque orders a bank to pay.

question_text: A drawer of a cheque is
option_a: The person who writes the cheque
explanation: The drawer writes the cheque.

question_text: A drawee of a cheque is
option_a: The bank on which the cheque is drawn
option_b: The person who writes the cheque
explanation: The drawee is the bank.

question_text: A payee of a cheque is
option_a: The person to whom the cheque is made payable
explanation: The payee receives the cheque amount.

question_text: A bearer cheque is payable to
option_a: Any person presenting it at the bank
explanation: Bearer cheques are payable to the bearer.

question_text: An order cheque is payable to
option_a: The named payee only
explanation: Order cheques are payable to the named payee.

question_text: A crossed cheque
option_a: Can only be paid into a bank account
option_b: Can be cashed over the counter
explanation: Crossed cheques must be paid into an account.

question_text: An open cheque
option_a: Can be cashed over the counter
option_b: Must be paid into an account
explanation: Open cheques can be cashed.

question_text: A stale cheque is one that is
option_a: More than six months old
explanation: Cheques older than six months are stale.

question_text: A post-dated cheque is one that
option_a: Bears a future date
option_d: Is more than six months old
explanation: Post-dated cheques bear future dates.

question_text: A dishonoured cheque is one that
option_a: The bank refuses to pay
explanation: Dishonoured cheques are not paid.

question_text: A cheque is dishonoured when
option_a: There are insufficient funds in the account
explanation: Insufficient funds cause dishonour.

question_text: An overdraft is
option_a: An arrangement to withdraw more than the balance in a current account
option_b: A loan for a fixed period
explanation: Overdrafts allow withdrawal beyond balance.

question_text: A bank loan is
option_a: A sum of money borrowed for a specified period at interest
explanation: Bank loans are borrowed sums at interest.

question_text: Which of the following is a type of bank?
option_a: Central bank
explanation: A central bank is a type of bank.

question_text: The central bank is responsible for
option_a: Issuing currency and controlling the money supply
explanation: Central banks issue currency and control money supply.

question_text: The central bank is the
option_a: Banker to the government
explanation: Central banks act as banker to government.

question_text: A merchant bank is mainly concerned with
option_a: Wholesale banking for companies
explanation: Merchant banks serve companies.

question_text: A development bank provides
option_a: Long-term finance for development projects
explanation: Development banks fund long-term projects.

question_text: Insurance is best defined as
option_a: A contract to compensate for specified losses in return for a premium
explanation: Insurance compensates losses for a premium.

question_text: A premium in insurance is
option_a: The amount paid for an insurance policy
explanation: Premium is the cost of insurance.

question_text: The insured is
option_a: The person or property covered by insurance
explanation: The insured is the covered party.

question_text: The insurer is
option_a: The insurance company
explanation: The insurer is the insurance company.

question_text: An insurance policy is
option_a: A document setting out the terms of insurance
explanation: A policy is the insurance contract.

question_text: Indemnity in insurance means
option_a: Restoring the insured to the position before the loss
explanation: Indemnity restores the insured.

question_text: Insurable interest means
option_a: The insured must benefit from the thing insured
explanation: Insurable interest is required for insurance.

question_text: Utmost good faith means
option_a: The insured must disclose all relevant facts
explanation: Utmost good faith requires full disclosure.

question_text: Which of the following is a principle of insurance?
option_a: Indemnity
explanation: Indemnity is a principle of insurance.

question_text: Which of the following is a type of insurance?
option_a: Life insurance
explanation: Life insurance is a type of insurance.

question_text: Life insurance is based on
option_a: The principle of certainty
explanation: Life insurance is certain as death is certain.

question_text: Fire insurance is based on
option_a: The principle of indemnity
explanation: Fire insurance indemnifies losses.

question_text: Marine insurance covers
option_a: Goods in transit by sea
explanation: Marine insurance covers sea transit.

question_text: Fidelity insurance covers
option_a: Losses due to dishonesty of employees
explanation: Fidelity insurance covers employee dishonesty.

question_text: Transportation is an aid to trade because it
option_a: Moves goods from producers to consumers
explanation: Transportation moves goods.

question_text: Which of the following is a mode of transport?
option_a: Road transport
explanation: Road transport is a mode of transport.

question_text: Road transport is suitable for
option_a: Short distances and door-to-door delivery
explanation: Road transport suits short distances.

question_text: Air transport is suitable for
option_a: Perishable and valuable goods over long distances
explanation: Air transport suits perishables and valuables.

question_text: Sea transport is suitable for
option_a: Heavy bulky goods over long distances
explanation: Sea transport suits bulky goods.

question_text: Rail transport is suitable for
option_a: Heavy bulky goods overland
explanation: Rail transport suits bulky goods.

question_text: Pipeline transport is suitable for
option_a: Liquids and gases
explanation: Pipelines carry liquids and gases.

question_text: Warehousing is an aid to trade because it
option_a: Stores goods until they are needed
explanation: Warehousing stores goods.

question_text: Which of the following is a type of warehouse?
option_a: Bonded warehouse
explanation: Bonded warehouses are a type of warehouse.

question_text: A bonded warehouse is one where
option_a: Duties are paid before goods are released
explanation: Goods in bonded warehouses are duty-suspended.

question_text: Advertising is an aid to trade because it
option_a: Informs consumers about goods and services
explanation: Advertising informs consumers.

question_text: Which of the following is a medium of advertising?
option_a: Newspaper
explanation: Newspapers are an advertising medium.

question_text: Communication is an aid to trade because it
option_a: Links buyers and sellers
explanation: Communication links buyers and sellers.

question_text: Which of the following is a means of communication?
option_a: Telephone
explanation: Telephone is a means of communication.
